title: Omi
description: Turns recorded conversations into searchable memories, summaries, extracted tasks, and daily recaps through a wearable and companion apps.

title: Ray-Ban Meta
description: Provides camera-grounded assistance, voice interaction, and user-set reminders through smart glasses paired with the Meta AI app.

title: PLAUD NotePin
description: Captures user-started in-person conversations for later transcription, summarization, and retrieval in the Plaud app.

title: Windows Recall
description: Stores opt-in screen snapshots locally and lets users search prior desktop activity with capture, filtering, and deletion controls.

title: screenpipe
description: Builds a searchable local history of screen and audio activity that users and connected agents can use for recall and follow-up work.

title: Claude Cowork
description: Runs delegated tasks across selected files and tools, with unattended scheduled work and results returned for review.

title: ChatGPT Pulse
description: Uses chat history, memory, feedback, and optional connected apps to prepare personalized research briefings between conversations.

title: Muse
description: Combines persistent conversational memory with scheduled and event-driven background work, surfacing meaningful updates or requests for input.

title: OpenClaw
description: Runs a personal assistant on user-managed infrastructure with durable memory, messaging access, and scheduled heartbeat checks or follow-ups.

title: Lindy
description: Uses connected inbox and calendar context to prepare meetings, draft replies, and handle post-meeting follow-ups.
